metadata.name: compare-images-hero
metadata.description: Phase-4 image-diff journey driving the visual-comparison surface end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /compare, loads two DISTINCT generated images into the base and compare file inputs (the keyboard/no-pointer path), and runs the comparison. Because the diff engine is pure-Go (no model, no GPU — like probe), the run resolves SYNCHRONOUSLY to a real verdict + metrics + heat-map with NO install gate. Asserting the verdict and metrics render proves the full file-input -> multipart compare edge (POST /api/v1/diff/compare) -> DiffResult parse -> structured-result + heat-map render wiring works against the live API. A broken DiffService, a regressed compare edge, a heat-map blob that never stores/fetches, or a result that never renders all fail here. This is a TRUE green success path (not an install gate), the strongest kind of headless journey.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 200; c.height = 200; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a'; g.fillRect(0,0,200,200); return new Promise((resolve) => { c.toBlob((blob) => { const file = new File([blob], 'base.png', { type: 'image/png' }); const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid="compare-base-file-input"]'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); resolve('base'); }, 'image/png'); }); })()
